Parts.Description: Dark volcanic ash split by glowing lava cracks, with a basalt plate under the Magma Shiba.
Parts.Name: Ash Fields

Parts.Description: A huge dark cone of stacked basalt with a glowing crater and lava stains running down its flanks.
Parts.Name: The Volcano

Parts.Description: A scorched basalt board on two posts that reads GET BONKED with an ember-red top edge.
Parts.Name: Get Bonked Sign

Parts.Description: A loose cluster of six-sided basalt columns of every height, like a giant's broken staircase.
Parts.Name: Basalt Columns

Parts.Description: Three small rocky mounds hissing white steam, each puffing at its own pace.
Parts.Name: Steam Vents

Parts.Description: A glowing river of lava winding down from the volcano and ending in a bubbling pool between dark banks.
Parts.Name: Lava River

Parts.Description: A thatched hut on four stilts with a little ladder, where the island guides rest.
Parts.Name: Tiki Hut

Parts.Description: A steaming turquoise pool ringed with warm boulders.
Parts.Name: Hot Spring

Parts.Description: Three carved wooden totem poles of different heights, grinning at everybody who passes.
Parts.Name: Tiki Totems

Parts.Description: A stone smithy with a glowing furnace, a tall chimney, an anvil and two cooling barrels.
Parts.Name: Obsidian Forge

Parts.Description: Two little tents round a crackling campfire with log seats.
Parts.Name: Explorer Camp

Parts.Description: Five bamboo torches planted at different heights, each with a flickering flame.
Parts.Name: Tiki Torches

Parts.Description: The huge ribcage and skull of an ancient lava beast half buried in the ash.
Parts.Name: Fossil Garden

Parts.Description: A timber-framed mine entrance cut into a rocky hill, with rails and an ore cart waiting outside.
Parts.Name: Old Mine

Parts.Description: A cluster of sharp red and orange crystals pushing up between the rocks.
Parts.Name: Ruby Crystals

Parts.Description: A small white research hut with a radio mast and satellite dish that watches the volcano for tremors.
Parts.Name: Seismo Station

Parts.Description: A wooden lookout on four tall legs with a little cabin and a red roof to spot eruptions early.
Parts.Name: Lookout Tower

Parts.Description: Four wind-bent palm trees with big green fronds growing on a warm patch of ground.
Parts.Name: Palm Grove

Parts.Description: A nest of dark twigs holding four warm speckled dragon eggs of different colours.
Parts.Name: Dragon Nest

Parts.Description: A steel derrick tower with a long drill pipe, a pump tank and a crown block on top.
Parts.Name: Geothermal Drill

Parts.Description: A great lava-stone dragon with spread wings and a long tail on a pedestal, guarding the west.
Parts.Name: Dragon Statue

Parts.Description: A four-step stone ziggurat with a dark shrine on top, braziers at the corners and a wide stair to the road.
Parts.Name: Obsidian Temple

Parts.Description: A great glowing crystal of molten rock on a round dais, with smaller shards and floating embers around it.
Parts.Name: Magma Heart

Parts.Description: A tall black throne with spiked back and ember red cushion on a round stone dais flanked by two braziers.
Parts.Name: Obsidian Throne

Parts.Description: The crowning show: a column of fire rising from the crater into a billowing ash cloud, with flying lava bombs.
Parts.Name: Great Eruption
